refreshSettings web path: when s.backend_url is set and device_id is empty in web mode it GETs {backend}/api/devices (httpFetch stamps Authorization: Bearer), accepts both {data:[]} and bare-array bodies, picks devices[0].device_id, persists via saveWebSettings, and continues to the config-fetch branch.
